item.title: Customs penalty built on fake AI citations set aside: update
item.description:
Vijay Ghanshyam Gadiya v. Union of India (Supreme Court)

The question: Can an adjudication relying on non-existent cases stand?

Where it stands: 2 September 2026: ₹425 crore penalty set aside and sent back to a different officer; "assistance can never be substituted for adjudication."

Decided 2026-09-02
